Udhayveer Sidhu Wins ISSF World Cup Gold in Men's 10m Air Pistol

Indian shooter Udhayveer Sidhu won the gold medal in the men's 10m air pistol event at the ISSF World Cup in Cairo. He defeated Olympic champion Christian Reitz to secure his first World Cup gold.
